research_question: Does online team-specific adaptation over fixed 45/90/180/360-day half-life experts improve the frozen current-season NB/Beta-Binomial core when all other parameters are held fixed?

design.learning_rate: eta_n=sqrt(2*ln(4)/n) for n>=1; uniform weights at n=0
design.same_day_update_policy: predict all matches first; apply all result-loss updates after the date batch
design.other_nb_beta_binomial_and_core_paramete: target-season existing PIT/OOS-selected formal parameters, unchanged
design.competition_level_state: formal baseline half-life; challenger mixes only team weighted sufficient statistics
design.calibration: disabled equally for baseline and challenger in this screen to avoid target-season outcome-fitted transform

governance.next_gate_if_promising: per-domain nested cross-season walk-forward + multi-window stability + prospective freeze before any promotion review
